title: Has Potion
description: Checks whether a living entity has the given potion effects.

title: Is Block
description: Checks whether an item type is a block.

title: Is Divisible
description: Checks whether a number is divisible by the given number.
syntax_pattern:
%numbers% (is|are) divisible by %number%
%number% (isn't|is not|aren't|are not) divisible by %number%

title: Is Prime
description: Checks whether the given number is prime.

title: Is Within
description: Checks whether the given location is between two locations.

title: Midi
description: Checks whether a midi with the given ID is playing.

title: Within Border
description: Checks whether the given locations are in the given world border.

title: File existance
description: Checks whether a file exists.
syntax_pattern:
file %string% (does|does(n't| not)) exist
existance of [file] %string% is %boolean%

title: Branch
description: Executes the lines below X times.

title: Clear Item Recipes
description: Clears all recipes for the given items.

title: Clear Recipes
description: Clears all recipes.

title: Client Block
description: Makes a player see a block as another type of block (e.g. client side). Any update from the server will change it back.

title: Client Sign
description: Makes a player see lines of a sign as the given texts (e.g. client side).
syntax_pattern: make %players% see lines of %blocks% as %string%, %string%, %string%( and|,) %string%

title: Escape
description: Skip the execution of a number of lines.

title: Evaluate Effect
description: Executes the given dynamic Skript effect code.

title: Execute Lambda
description: Executes the given lambda, optionally X of times.

title: Homing
description: Makes an entity go back to the given location. Using 'normally' reduces some bugs caused by varying distances, but makes it less accurate.
syntax_pattern:
make %entity% home towards %location%
make %entities% home towards %location% normally

title: Leash
description: Leash living entities to other entities.

title: MIDI
description: Plays a midi from a file or an URL to the specified players optionally with specified tempo and ID.
syntax_pattern:
play midi [from] %string% (for|to) %players% [at [tempo] %number%] [with id %string%]
play midi from (website|link) %string% (for|to) %players% [at [tempo] %number%] [with id %string%]

title: MIDI Stop
description: Stops the midi with the ID.

title: Make Damage
description: Makes a living entity damage another.

title: Make Say
description: Forces a player to send a message to the chat. If the message starts with a slash it will force the player to use command.

title: Option Developer Mode
description: Makes the script automatically reload if a change have been made.

title: Option Skript Permissions Manager
description: Makes SkQuery a permissions manager on the server. You will then be able to access the expressions that represent player permissions and change them.

title: Option Thread
description: Makes the next line run on a different thread. The code below the next line will be delayed until the thread finishes. Please note that Bukkit stuff aren't thread safe.

title: Pathfind
description: Makes a living entity pathfind to the given location with the specified speed.

title: Player Visibility
description: Change visibility of a player for the given players. If a player was hidden and relogs, this player will be visible again.

title: Pop
description: Instantly detonates a firework effect at the given location. Having multiple effects will cause them to stack.

title: Set Block Without Update
description: Set blocks to another type of blocks without causing surrounding blocks to update.

title: Shoot Item Projectile
description: Shoots an item from a living entity with the specified speed.

title: Show Credits
description: Shows the end credists to the given player.

title: Stop Server
description: Shutdowns the server.

title: Tame
description: Tames given entities to a player.

title: Texture
description: Sends a resource pack from an URL to the specified players.

title: Trail
description: Makes trail of particles for the projectile in a shoot event.

title: Value at Index
description: Returns the value at the given index of a list.

title: Art
description: The art of a painting. Can be set or reset.

title: Blast Radius
description: The explosion strength of an explosive entity (like primed TNT, fireballs and wither skull). Can be set or reset.

title: Block Chunk
description: Returns the blocks in a chunk. Can be changed.

title: Block Cube
description: Returns the blocks between two locations as a cube. Can be changed.

title: Block in Chunk
description: The block at the given coordinates in a chunk. Can be changed.

title: Border
description: The world border of a world. Can be deleted or reset.

title: Arrow Critical State
description: The critical state of an arrow. Can be set or reset.

title: Border Center
description: The center location of a world border. Can be set.

title: Border Damage Amount
description: The damage amount of a world border. Can be set.

title: Border Damage Buffer
description: The damage buffer (amount of blocks a player may safely be outside the border before taking damage) of a world border. Can be set. Default is 5.

title: Border Size
description: The size of a world border. Can be changed.

title: Border Warning Distance
description: The warning distance of a world border. Can be set.

title: Border Warning Time
description: The warning time of a world border. Can be changed.

title: Character index
description: Returns the character at the given index of a text.

title: Check
description: Returns the result of a predicate.

title: Complicated Math
syntax_pattern:
sin[e] %number%
cos[ine] %number%
tan[gent] %number%
arc sin[e] %number%
arc cos[ine] %number%
arc tan[gent] %number%
hyperbolic sin[e] %number%
hyperbolic cos[ine] %number%
hyperbolic tan[gent] %number%
[natural ]log[arithm] %number%
base(-| )10 log[arithm] %number%
signum %number%
(sqrt|square root)[ of] %number%
(%number% factorial|%number%!)

title: Direction From to
description: Returns the direction from a location to another location.

title: Enchant Level
description: Returns the enchantment cost in an enchant event.

title: Entities of Chunk
description: Returns all entities in a chunk. Can be added to or remove from.

title: Exploded Blocks
description: Returns the exploded blocks in an explode event.

title: Fake Max Players
description: The fake maximum player count in a server list ping event. Can be set.

title: Flight Mode
description: Whether the given players are allowed to fly.

title: Former Location
description: The former location in a player move event.

title: Glowing Item Stack
description: Returns glowing items.

title: Hotbar Slot
description: The selected hotbar slot index of a player (0-9). Can be changed!

title: Inventory Name
description: Gets the title of the viewed inventory in an inventory click event.

title: Item Stack Size
description: Can be changed.

title: Random Text
description: Returns a random text generated from the given regex.

title: Land Boats
description: Whether a boat can work on land. Might not work as expected on some Minecraft versions.

title: Loaded Chunks
description: Returns the loaded chunks of the given worlds.

title: Health Scale Mode
description: Whether the player should see their health as scaled. See the [Health Scale](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=3934) expression.

title: Image from URL
description: Gets the image from a direct image link.

title: Local Image
description: Gets the image of a local PNG file. See examples.

title: Max Minecart Speed
description: The maximum speed of a minecart. Can be set. The default is 0.4.

title: Modulus
description: Returns the modulo of the given numbers, i.e. the remainder of the division of them.

title: Moon Phase
description: Returns the current moon phase of a world.

title: New Line
description: A line break (LF). Can be used in so many places like messages, books, MOTD, files...

title: New UUID
description: Returns a random UUID.

title: Nth Prime
description: Returns the nth prime number.

title: Plugin Version
description: Returns the version of a plugin.

title: Primer
description: The entity that primed the given tNT.
syntax_pattern:
[the] (primer|fuse lighting piece of shit) of %entities%
%entities%'[s] (primer|fuse lighting piece of shit)

title: Regain Reason
description: The regen cause in a heal event.

title: Tame Owner
description: The owner of a tameable animal. Can be set or reset.

title: Tile Entities
description: Returns all tile entities in a chunk. Can be changed.

title: Player Time
description: Client side time of a player. Can be set or reset.

title: Villager Job
description: The profession of a villager. Can be set or reset.

title: Art
type_usage: kebab, aztec, alban, aztec2, bomb, plant, wasteland, pool, courbet, sea, sunset, creebet, wanderer, graham, match, bust, stage, void, skull and roses, wither, fighters, pointer, pigscene, burning skull, skeleton, donkey kong

title: Moon Phase
type_usage: new moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, full moon, waning gibbous, last quarter, waning crescent

title: Particle
type_usage: explosion normal, explosion large, explosion huge, fireworks spark, water bubble, water splash, water wake, suspended, suspended depth, crit, crit magic, smoke normal, smoke large, spell, spell instant, spell mob, spell mob ambient, spell witch, drip water, drip lava, villager angry, villager happy, town aura, note, portal, enchantment table, flame, lava, cloud, redstone, snowball, snow shovel, slime, heart, barrier, item crack, block crack, block dust, water drop, mob appearance, dragon breath, end rod, damage indicator, sweep attack, falling dust, totem, spit, squid ink, bubble pop, current down, bubble column up, nautilus, dolphin, legacy block crack, legacy block dust, legacy falling dust

title: Profession
type_usage: normal, farmer, librarian, priest, blacksmith, butcher, nitwit, husk

title: Regain Reason
type_usage: regen, satiated, eating, ender crystal, magic, magic regen, wither spawn, wither, custom

title: Number to Roman Numeral
description: Returns a number converted to roman numeral.

title: Roman Numeral to Number
description: Returns a roman numeral converted to number.

title: Arrow Knockback Strength
description: The knockback strength of an arrow. Can be set or reset.

title: Health Scale
description:
The number to scale the health the player sees. Can be changed and changing this will also enable [scaled health mode](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=3935).

The formula to display the health is: `health / max health * health scale`

title: Incendiary Explosion
description: Whether an explosive entity (primed TNT, fireballs and wither skull) should cause fire.

title: Server Icon
description:
The server icon in a server list ping event. Will always return nothing, can be set to an image.
See also: [Local Image](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=3937) and [Image from URL](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=3938) expressions

title: On Server List Ping
description:
Called when a server list ping is coming in, generally when a Minecraft client pings the server to show its information in the server list.
See also: [MOTD](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=3946), [Server Icon](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=3962) and [Fake Max Players](https://skripthub.net/docs/?id=3930) expressions

title: On Falling Block Land
description: Called when a falling block lands. The `event-block` will be the block that the falling block will land to, waiting a tick would give the landed block.

title: Player Time (Relative)
description:
Client side time of a player. If 'relative', the time will be relative to the world (so it will be changing and the `doDaylightCycle` gamerule affects it), otherwise the time will stay fixed.
Can be set or reset.

title: New Recipe
description: Registers a new crafting recipe. All 9 slots must be present, use `air` to indicate the slot is not used.
syntax_pattern:
register new shaped recipe for %itemtype% using %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%
register new shapeless recipe for %itemtype% using %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%, %itemtype%
